review.tagline: OpenAI-compatible router that pools free LLM provider tiers behind one endpoint
review.summary: FreeLLMAPI exposes a single /v1 API (chat, responses, embeddings, images, audio, plus Anthropic Messages, Gemini and Ollama surfaces) and routes requests across free tiers from 34 providers. It stores provider keys AES-256-GCM encrypted in SQLite, tracks RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD per key, and fails over to the next model on 429/5xx. A React dashboard manages keys and the fallback chain; a desktop app is also available.
review.audience: Developers and self-hosters stretching free LLM tiers across agents
strengths: Per-key rate counters and automatic failover on 429/5xx across providers
Covers chat, embeddings, images, video, speech, Anthropic, Gemini and Ollama APIs
Keys encrypted at rest in SQLite; clients only see one unified token
Setup commands for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider and other agents
weaknesses: Free installs get new models 30 days late; same-day catalog needs $19/yr premium
Local-first and single-user by design; no multi-user support
Depends on free-tier quotas that providers change without notice
Model catalog sync pulls a signed feed from freellmapi.co
needs: Needs Node.js 20+, SQLite, Docker (optional), provider API keys
Models: OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic Messages, Gemini API, Ollama API, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
